title: BabyTheorist: A Benchmark for Learning to Theorize the World from Observation Alone
abstract: arXiv:2611.08177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How would we know whether a machine truly understands the world? We argue that one key capability is \textit{observational theory learning}: acquiring reusable theories from pure observations and applying them to new situations. Current visual reasoning benchmarks focus primarily on the latter, presenting each task as a few-shot puzzle grouped by a common rule. We introduce BabyTheorist, a benchmark for controlled training and evaluation of observational theory learning. BabyTheorist generates continual streams of before-after visual observations from hidden compositional programs; during training, learners see only the resulting transitions, with no program labels, task identities, or support sets. To support theory learning and evaluation, BabyTheorist controls the program language, a curriculum over program complexity, recurring frequent subprograms, and a continual train-test protocol with level skipping. translated_title: BabyTheorist：一个从纯观察中学习理论化理解世界的基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们如何判断一台机器是否真正理解世界？我们认为其中一项关键能力是“观察性理论学习”：从纯观察中获取可复用的理论，并将其应用于新的情境。当前的视觉推理基准主要关注后者，即将每个任务呈现为按共同规则分组的少样本谜题。我们提出了 BabyTheorist，这是一个用于观察性理论学习的受控训练与评估基准。BabyTheorist 从隐藏的组合程序中生成连续的“前后”视觉观察流；在训练过程中，学习者只能看到最终的转换结果，而无法获得程序标签、任务身份或支持集。为了支持理论的学习与评估，BabyTheorist 对程序语言、程序复杂度的课程安排、反复出现的频繁子程序，以及带有级别跳跃的连续训练-测试协议进行了控制。文中评估了七个代表性基线……
tldr: 提出了 BabyTheorist 基准，用于评估模型能否仅凭纯视觉观察学习可复用的世界理论，并将其泛化应用到全新情境中。
en_tdlr: BabyTheorist is a benchmark for evaluating observational theory learning, where models must acquire reusable theories purely from visual observations and apply them to novel situations.
